newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian August primary aluminum exports 204,980 T.
newsitem.headline: Russian August primary aluminum exports 204,980 T.

text.p: Russian exports of primary aluminium were 204,980 tonnes in August, Interfax news agency quoted State Customs Committee figures as showing on Tuesday.
It said August exports of aluminium alloy were 17,060 tonnes.
Russian primary aluminium output over the first eight months of this year was 1,883,000 tonnes, an increase of 2.3 percent on year ago levels, it said.

The State Statistics Committee said earlier this month that primary aluminium exports outside the Commonwealth of Independent States over the first eight months of 1996 were nearly 1.755 million tonnes.

But Interfax, still quoting State Customs Committee figures, said exports of primary aluminium and aluminium alloy over the same period were 1.731 million tonnes, a 22.6 percent increase year-on-year.
No other comparative figures were provided.
